mapper.select: where user_id = #{userId} order by create_time desc

mapper.select: select count(*) as totalCount, sum(case when consultation_channel = '1' and date(create_time) = curdate() then 1 else 0 end) as todayVoice, sum(case when consultation_channel = '2' and date(create_time) = curdate() then 1 else 0 end) as todayImageText, sum(case when consultation_channel = '3' and date(create_time) = curdate() then 1 else 0 end) as todayVideo, sum(case when date(create_time) = curdate() then 1 else 0 end) as todayTotal, sum(case when consultation_channel = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as voiceTotal, sum(case when consultation_channel = '2' then 1 else 0 end) as imageTextTotal, sum(case when consultation_channel = '3' then 1 else 0 end) as videoTotal from ai_legal_consultation
select count(*) from ai_legal_consultation where date(create_time) = curdate()
select count(*) from ai_legal_consultation where yearweek(date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d'), 1) = yearweek(curdate(), 1)
select count(*) from ai_legal_consultation where date_format(create_time, '%Y%m') = date_format(curdate(), '%Y%m')
select count(*) from ai_legal_consultation where status = #{status}
select avg(rating) from ai_legal_consultation where rating is not null

select c.category_id as categoryId, c.category_name as categoryName, count(q.consultation_id) as count from ai_consultation_category c left join ai_legal_consultation q on q.category_id = c.category_id where c.del_flag = '0' group by c.category_id, c.category_name order by count desc, c.category_id asc

with recursive nums(n) as ( select 0 union all select n + 1 from nums where n < #{days} - 1 ) select date_format(d.dt, '%Y-%m-%d') as date, count(q.consultation_id) as count from ( select date_sub(curdate(), interval n day) as dt from nums ) d left join ai_legal_consultation q on date(q.create_time) = d.dt group by d.dt order by d.dt
